content.title: Is Publix open on Easter 2026? Here’s what's open and closed on Easter
content.text: SynopsisPublix will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026, across Florida, including its pharmacies and liquor stores. However, shoppers can find many other grocery options open, such as Walmart, Winn-Dixie, Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, and Sprouts. It is advisable to check specific store hours as some may have reduced operating times.APIs Publix open on Easter 2026? Here’s what's open and closed on EasterIf you’re planning a last-minute Easter meal run, it’s important to know which grocery stores are open before heading out. For many shoppers, the big question this holiday weekend is what stores are open on Easter.Easter 2026 will be observed by the majority of Christians, with a particular emphasis on Catholics and Protestants, on Sunday, April 5, 2026.Easter normally occurs on the first Sunday following the Paschal Full Moon, which is the first full moon following the spring equinox on the Gregorian calendar, which is employed by the majority of Christian denominations. In Christianity, Easter is the commemoration of Jesus Christ's resurrection, which marked his triumph over sin and death.Easter Sunday falls on April 5, 2026, and people are checking store hours for last-minute holiday needs. ALSO READ: Oracle Layoffs: Thousands being fired via email without warning—here's what lead to the global restructuringIs Publix open on Easter?No, Publix will be closed on Easter Sunday. This includes all regular grocery locations, as well as Publix liquor stores and pharmacies, as per reports by the Miami Herald and TC Palm.Publix traditionally closes only three times each year: Thanksgiving, Christmas, and Easter, making this one of the few days the popular Florida supermarket chain does not operate.ALSO READ: As Iran downs US jets - did they find the second pilot? Here's the latest What grocery stores are open on Easter 2026?Thankfully, several other stores remain open for Easter shopping.Stores open on Easter include Walmart, Winn-Dixie, Milam’s Markets, Sedano’s Supermarket, Presidente Supermarket, Trader Joe’s, Sprouts Farmers Market, Whole Foods Market, The Fresh Market, and BJ’s Warehouse Club.Most Whole Foods locations in South Florida are open from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m., though some stores may close earlier at 6 p.m.Other open options include Price Choice Supermarket, though some locations may shut by 2 p.m. Convenience stores and gas station mini-marts are also generally open, as per reports by the Miami Herald and TC Palm.Which places are closed for Easter?Along with Publix, several stores and restaurants will be closed, including Target, Costco, Sam’s Club, and Aldi.A number of restaurant chains are also closed for the holiday, including Arby’s, CAVA, Chipotle, Culver’s, Firehouse Subs, Mission BBQ, Raising Cane’s, and Zaxby’s, as per reports by the Miami Herald and TC Palm.FAQsIs Publix open on Easter Sunday 2026?No, all Publix stores, pharmacies, and liquor stores will be closed.Which grocery stores are open on Easter?Walmart, Winn-Dixie, Whole Foods, Trader Joe’s, Sprouts, and BJ’s are open.
